rounds.name: ground
rounds.prompt: Edit the supplied Openfold riverbank study to make a CLEAN STATIC GROUND LAYER. Preserve the exact path, shoreline, rocks, water and their positions. Remove ALL tall grass clumps, upright blades and reeds everywhere; replace their footprints naturally with low flat moss-green turf, bare soil or gravel matching the adjacent ground. No upright vegetation may remain; tiny flat turf speckling is okay. In particular remove the three shoreline reed clusters without moving rocks or water. Keep painterly crisp pixel-art material detail, same palette and same camera. This is only the static substrate that separate animated plant sprites will stand on. No new objects or text.
